## A margin cell on a slide

```{r}
#| label: fig-slide-margin-cell
#| fig-cap: "A cell figure with column margin on a slide."
#| column: margin
#| classes: wrap-right
plot(1:10)
```

The paragraph after the cell sits beside its figure, because slides have no margin column. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.

## An aside on a slide

::: {.aside}
![A figure in an aside on a slide.](plot.png){#fig-slide-aside .wrap-right width="40%"}

The paragraph after the figure. By default, revealjs puts an aside at the foot of the slide, so the figure keeps its normal layout.
:::
